subject: SOC2 sampling & logs runbook coordination
messages:
From: Sara Ahmed <sara.ahmed@vanguardhealth.io>
To: Grace O'Connor <grace@redwood.com>
Cc: Liam Brooks <liam.brooks@vanguardhealth.io>
Date: Fri, 18 Dec 2026 14:02:00 -0800
Subject: SOC2 evidence sampling & logs runbook - coordination

Hi Grace,

Thanks again for the demo last week. Vanguard's audit team is preparing the SOC 2 readiness packet and we've been asked to get a short runbook and sampling plan from our vendors. Can we schedule a 30-minute sync to cover: scope (CAI Q/SIG/SOC2 overlap), log retention windows, log sampling mechanics (snapshots vs exporters), and a short list of artifact examples you can provide?

Preferred windows next week: Mon 12/21 09:00-11:00 PT or Tue 12/22 13:00-15:00 PT. If those don't work we can be flexible.

A couple of quick asks to speed up the call:
- Can you confirm whether Redwood can export 30/60-day raw access logs for a customer tenant (S3/secure transfer)?
- Do you support point-in-time telemetry exports (WAL/stream) or only aggregated log bundles?
- Any standard SOC 2 artifact names for the ops runbook we should ask for?

I've attached our internal questionnaire priorities so you can see what the audit team will focus on (high level).

Thanks,

Sara Ahmed
Security Program Manager
Vanguard Health
[Attachment: vanguard-questionnaire-priorities.pdf (application/pdf, 120KB)]

From: Grace O'Connor <grace@redwood.com>
To: Sara Ahmed <sara.ahmed@vanguardhealth.io>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 18 Dec 2026 15:18:00 -0800
Subject: Re: SOC2 evidence sampling & logs runbook - coordination

Hi Sara — great to connect. 30 minutes should be enough to align on scope and handoff. I can do Mon 12/21 at 09:30 PT; Marcus and Neha will join for the ops & evidence questions.

Quick answers to your pre-asks:
- We can provide 30- and 60-day raw access logs for a dedicated tenant. Delivery options: secure S3 transfer or an encrypted Drive link.
- We currently offer both bulk log bundles (rotated daily) and a near-real-time export stream for enterprise customers via our secure log-push endpoint. Point-in-time WAL snapshots are not standard but we can export archived shards if necessary — we should scope that on the call.
- We'll prepare a short artifact index (ops runbook, audit logs index, key rotation proof, IAM role list) and link it in the Drive folder prior to the meeting.

Proposed agenda (30m):
1) Confirm scope (SOC 2 trust services + CAIQ overlap) — 5m
2) Log retention and access methods (S3 vs export endpoint) — 10m
3) Sampling plan and artifacts (what we can hand off within 48 hours) — 10m
4) Next steps & owners — 5m

I'll send a calendar invite for Mon 12/21 09:30 PT. If that time doesn't work, let me know.

Best,

Grace O'Connor
Head of Customer Security
Redwood Inference
Cell: (415) 555-0191
[Redwood Inference]

From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
To: Grace O'Connor <grace@redwood.com>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 18 Dec 2026 15:45:00 -0800
Subject: Re: SOC2 evidence sampling & logs runbook - coordination

Adding a few technical bullets for the call:
- For S3 exports we can deliver gzipped daily bundles with a manifest (checksum + time range). Typical retention window for hosted tenants is 90 days by default; Dedicated customers often request longer (we've supported up to 365 days).
- If Vanguard needs a point-in-time artifact (e.g., evidence of a particular incident window), we can pull archived shards but need approval for an extraction run.
- I'll bring the log manifest template and a sample runbook PDF to the call. Grace — should I drop those into the Drive link before the meeting?

Marcus
Senior Systems Engineer, Redwood Inference

From: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
To: Sara Ahmed <sara.ahmed@vanguardhealth.io>, Liam Brooks <liam.brooks@vanguardhealth.io>
Cc: Grace O'Connor <grace@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 21 Dec 2026 08:10:00 -0800
Subject: Prep materials: runbook + artifact index for Monday

Hi Sara / Liam — thanks for confirming the slot. Per our conversation, I've uploaded a short prep packet to a shared Drive folder and attached a slimmed-down runbook for Vanguard's audit team. The packet includes:
- redwood-soc2-asklist.xlsx (checklist mapped to common auditor questions)
- runbook-ops.pdf (sample operational runbook with retention and export steps)
- log-manifest-sample.json (example manifest format)

Please confirm you have Drive access: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1aBcdExampleDriveLink

Notes / pre-answers to your original questions:
- Export formats: .gz bundles (daily) or JSON newline-delimited manifests; secure S3 transfer is preferred for large pulls.
- Snapshot capability: we can schedule an extraction job for a given UTC window (requires 48-hour lead time).
- Artifact naming convention: redwood-<tenant>-logs-YYYYMMDD.gz; runbook-redwood-<tenant>-v1.pdf; iam-roles-<tenant>-YYYYMMDD.csv

Attachments: [Attachment: redwood-soc2-asklist.xlsx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet, 58KB)] [Attachment: runbook-ops.pdf (application/pdf, 74KB)]

See you on the call.

Best,

Neha Kapoor
Security & Compliance Analyst
Redwood Inference

From: Liam Brooks <liam.brooks@vanguardhealth.io>

Date: Mon, 20 Dec 2026 09:18:00 -0800

Thanks all — the 09:30 PT slot works for Vanguard. Quick clarifications ahead of the call:
- We have an agreed NDA in place so extraction approvals are cleared on our side.
- For the audit we're prioritizing: access logs, admin role change history (last 180 days), and proof of key rotation cadence. If you can flag which artifacts map to those items in the Drive doc that would be helpful.

I'll join with Sara and our auditor (cc'd on the invite). Looking forward to the runbook.

Liam Brooks
Sr. IT Auditor
Vanguard Health
